The '''Nosken system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[Booster Terrik]]'s private [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', was stationed here for a complete refurbishment in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]. At the beginning of the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], [[Talon Karrde]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] were aboard the ''Errant Venture'' when the system was visited by an [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|unidentified starfighter]].<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
